_status: draft: AI-written, needs editorial review by an astrologer

sun.name: Sun
sun.short: The Sun shows your core identity, your vitality and what makes you shine.

moon.name: Moon
moon.short: The Moon shows your emotions, what makes you feel safe and your inner needs.

mercury.name: Mercury
mercury.short: Mercury shows how you think, speak and learn.

venus.name: Venus
venus.short: Venus shows what you love, what you value and how you seek harmony in relationships.

mars.name: Mars
mars.short: Mars shows what you go after, how you take action and where you direct your energy.

jupiter.name: Jupiter
jupiter.archetype: Expansion, abundance, luck, wisdom: the planet of abundance.
jupiter.short: Jupiter shows where you grow, where your faith lies and where life opens up generously.

saturn.name: Saturn
saturn.short: Saturn shows where you carry responsibility, learn patience and grow stronger over time.

uranus.name: Uranus
uranus.short: Uranus shows where you want to be different, free and open to sudden change.

neptune.name: Neptune
neptune.short: Neptune shows your dreams, your intuition and the sensitive area where boundaries dissolve.

pluto.name: Pluto
pluto.short: Pluto shows where you go through deep change and discover your inner power.

northNode.name: North Node
northNode.short: The North Node shows your direction of growth: the path that moves you forward even when it feels unfamiliar.

southNode.name: South Node
southNode.short: The South Node shows familiar habits you already master, and where you may get stuck.

lilith.name: Lilith (Black Moon)
lilith.short: Lilith shows suppressed instincts and the part of you that refuses to submit.

chiron.name: Chiron
chiron.short: Chiron shows a sensitive wound, and the wisdom that lets you help others as you understand it.

partOfFortune.name: Part of Fortune
partOfFortune.short: The Part of Fortune shows where life flows more easily and where you find contentment.

asc.name: Ascendant
asc.short: The Ascendant shows how you present yourself to the world and the first impression you make.

mc.name: Midheaven
mc.short: The Midheaven shows your career direction, public role and what you want to be known for.

dc.name: Descendant
dc.short: The Descendant shows the qualities you seek in partners and learn through relationships.

ic.name: Imum Coeli
ic.short: The Imum Coeli shows your roots, your family and your inner refuge.

aries.name: Aries
aries.expression: In Aries this energy is expressed boldly, directly and with initiative: quick to start and frank to speak.

taurus.name: Taurus
taurus.expression: In Taurus this energy is expressed calmly, patiently and steadily: it seeks stability, comfort and tangible results.

gemini.name: Gemini
gemini.expression: In Gemini this energy is expressed with curiosity, agility and sociability: it wants to learn, ask and share.

cancer.name: Cancer
cancer.expression: In Cancer this energy is expressed sensitively, caringly and protectively: it seeks emotional safety and closeness.

leo.name: Leo
leo.expression: In Leo this energy is expressed warmly, creatively and generously: it wants to be seen, loved and to create from the heart.

virgo.name: Virgo
virgo.expression: In Virgo this energy is expressed precisely, attentively and usefully: it wants to improve, organise and help.

libra.name: Libra
libra.expression: In Libra this energy is expressed gracefully, diplomatically and in balance: it seeks harmony, beauty and fairness.

scorpio.name: Scorpio
scorpio.expression: In Scorpio this energy is expressed deeply, intensely and loyally: it wants to get past the surface to the truth.

sagittarius.name: Sagittarius
sagittarius.expression: In Sagittarius this energy is expressed optimistically, openly and freely: it seeks meaning, travel and wide horizons.

capricorn.name: Capricorn
capricorn.expression: In Capricorn this energy is expressed seriously, purposefully and with endurance: it wants to build something solid, step by step.

aquarius.name: Aquarius
aquarius.expression: In Aquarius this energy is expressed originally, independently and with an eye on the future: it thinks differently and wants change together.

pisces.name: Pisces
pisces.expression: In Pisces this energy is expressed sensitively, dreamily and compassionately: it flows with intuition and longs for wholeness.

1.name: 1st house
1.expression: In the 1st house this theme shows clearly in your personality and how you present yourself.

2.name: 2nd house
2.expression: In the 2nd house this theme is lived through money, possessions, skills and self-worth.

3.name: 3rd house
3.expression: In the 3rd house this theme shows in communication, learning, siblings and your close surroundings.

4.name: 4th house
4.expression: In the 4th house this theme is lived through home, family, roots and a sense of inner security.

5.name: 5th house
5.expression: In the 5th house this theme shows in creativity, romance, children and the joy of living.

6.name: 6th house
6.expression: In the 6th house this theme is lived through daily work, habits, service and caring for your health.

7.name: 7th house
7.expression: In the 7th house this theme shows in partnerships, marriage and committed relationships.

8.name: 8th house
8.expression: In the 8th house this theme is lived through deep bonds, shared resources and life-changing crises.

9.name: 9th house
9.expression: In the 9th house this theme shows in travel, higher education, belief and worldview.

10.name: 10th house
10.expression: In the 10th house this theme is visible in your career, public reputation and life purpose.

11.name: 11th house
11.expression: In the 11th house this theme is lived through friendship, community, teamwork and hopes for the future.

12.name: 12th house
12.expression: In the 12th house this theme is lived in your inner world, in solitude, dreams and unseen processes.

conjunction.name: Conjunction
conjunction.meaning: The two energies merge and amplify each other.

opposition.name: Opposition
opposition.meaning: The two energies stand at opposite poles; the task is balance and seeing yourself in the other.

trine.name: Trine
trine.meaning: The two energies flow naturally together, giving talent and ease.

square.name: Square
square.meaning: There is tension between the two energies; the friction drives growth and action.

sextile.name: Sextile
sextile.meaning: The two energies support each other; the opportunity is there, but the step is yours to take.

quincunx.name: Quincunx
quincunx.meaning: The two energies don't quite understand each other; constant small adjustments are needed.

semisextile.name: Semi-sextile
semisextile.meaning: A light, subtle link; a chance for small adjustments.

semisquare.name: Semi-square
semisquare.meaning: Minor but persistent irritation; friction that asks for attention.

sesquiquadrate.name: Sesquiquadrate
sesquiquadrate.meaning: Hidden tension; a challenge that surfaces from time to time.

grandTrine.name: Grand Trine
grandTrine.meaning: Three planets form an equilateral triangle: natural talent and easy flow, with a risk of staying too comfortable.

tSquare.name: T-Square
tSquare.meaning: Two opposing planets put pressure on a third: the apex planet shows the main life challenge and its driving force.

grandCross.name: Grand Cross
grandCross.meaning: Four planets form a cross: tension from every side builds great endurance and strength.

yod.name: Yod (Finger of Fate)
yod.meaning: Two planets point at a third: the apex is a special mission and an area of constant adjustment.

kite.name: Kite
kite.meaning: A fourth planet joins a grand trine: talent gains a concrete direction and purpose.

mysticRectangle.name: Mystic Rectangle
mysticRectangle.meaning: Two oppositions joined by trines and sextiles: tension turns into practical harmony.

stellium.name: Stellium
stellium.meaning: Three or more planets gather in one place: this theme carries special weight in your life.

domicile.name: Domicile
domicile.meaning: The planet is in its own sign: its energy flows naturally and strongly.

exaltation.name: Exaltation
exaltation.meaning: The planet is exalted: its best qualities shine.

detriment.name: Detriment
detriment.meaning: The planet is opposite its own sign: expressing it takes extra effort.

fall.name: Fall
fall.meaning: The planet is in its fall: maturity in this area is earned over time.

1.name: The Magician
1.plus: Starting new things and inspiring people through words and ideas.
1.minus: Manipulation, scattered energy, starting without finishing.

2.name: The High Priestess
2.plus: Deep intuition, a gift for learning and teaching, trust in the inner voice.

3.name: The Empress
3.plus: Care, beauty, abundance and creative energy.

4.name: The Emperor
4.plus: Responsibility, building stability, leadership and decisiveness.

5.name: The Hierophant
5.plus: Passing on knowledge, giving spiritual direction, respect for family and tradition.
5.minus: Dogmatism, preaching, clinging to old rules.

6.name: The Lovers
6.plus: Loving from the heart, seeing beauty, making the right choice.

7.name: The Chariot
7.plus: Moving towards goals, travel, winning through will.

8.name: Justice
8.plus: Fairness, understanding cause and effect, clear decisions.
8.minus: Judging others, resentment, powerlessness before injustice.

9.name: The Hermit
9.plus: Deep thought, finding your own path, lighting the way for others.

10.name: Wheel of Fortune
10.plus: Openness to change, seeing chances, moving with the rhythm of life.
10.minus: Passivity, leaving everything to fate, instability.

11.name: Strength
11.plus: Great vital energy, mastering emotions, compassionate strength.

12.name: The Hanged Man
12.plus: Seeing the world differently, service, deep understanding.

13.name: Death
13.plus: Letting go of the old to make room for the new; the power to transform.
13.minus: Fear of change, clinging to the past, destructiveness.

14.name: Temperance
14.plus: Calm, adaptability, bringing harmony and healing to people.

15.name: The Devil
15.plus: Charisma, financial skill, using power well.
15.minus: Addictions, manipulation, giving in to desires.

16.name: The Tower
16.plus: Tearing down false structures and building anew, sincere creativity.
16.minus: Sudden crises, stubbornness, destroying what is around you.

17.name: The Star
17.minus: Fear of being seen, living in dreams.

19.name: The Sun
19.plus: Warmth, optimism, success and sharing energy with others.

20.name: Judgement
20.plus: Bond with the family, awakening, learning from past experience.
20.minus: Ancestral burdens, not forgiving, being stuck in the past.

21.name: The World
21.plus: A broad worldview, travel, going beyond borders.

22.name: The Fool
22.plus: Freedom, spontaneity, play and openness to the new.

B.name: Second half of character

E.name: Comfort zone

M.name: Readiness for relationships

N.name: Karmic tail (middle)
N.meaning: An unresolved task carried from the past.

S.name: Inner core
S.meaning: The quality that leads to the comfort zone.

T.name: Path to the heart
T.meaning: Spiritual talent expressed close to the core.

R.name: Love and money node
R.meaning: The main block and growth point in love and money.

R1.name: Character of the relationship
R1.meaning: The general tone of your partnerships.

R2.name: Profession and success
R2.meaning: The professional sphere that brings success.

F2.meaning: A talent from the father's line.

G1.meaning: A programme passed down the mother's line.

H2.meaning: The father's-line energy near the centre.

I1.meaning: A material programme from the mother's side.

I2.meaning: The mother's-line energy near the centre.

L1.meaning: The sum of the personal and ancestral centres.

L2.name: Ancestral centre
L2.meaning: The centre of the ancestral square.

earth.name: Earth line
earth.meaning: Material skills, showing up in the world.

personal.meaning: Finding yourself, balancing sky and earth.

male.name: Male line
male.meaning: The influence of the father's line.

female.name: Female line
female.meaning: The influence of the mother's line.

social.meaning: Your role in society, with family and people.

spiritual.meaning: The highest task of the soul.

sun.name: Sun (Surya)
sun.dasha: A period of self-confidence, father, authority, health and leadership.

moon.name: Moon (Chandra)
moon.dasha: A period of emotions, mother, home, comfort and public contact.

mars.name: Mars (Mangala)
mars.dasha: A period of energy, courage, land and property, siblings and competition.

mercury.name: Mercury (Budha)
mercury.dasha: A period of learning, trade, communication and intellectual work.

jupiter.name: Jupiter (Guru)
jupiter.dasha: A period of wisdom, growth, children, teachers and blessings.

venus.name: Venus (Shukra)
venus.dasha: A period of love, marriage, beauty, art and comfort.

saturn.name: Saturn (Shani)
saturn.dasha: A period of patience, duty, hard work, discipline and maturity.

rahu.name: Rahu (North Node)
rahu.dasha: A period of ambition, unusual opportunities, foreign links and sudden change.

ketu.name: Ketu (South Node)
ketu.dasha: A period of turning inward, spirituality, detachment and letting go.

lagna.name: Lagna (Ascendant)
lagna.dasha: Body, character and the starting point of the life path.

1.name: Leader
1.meaning: The energy that opens its own path, takes the first step and leads others.

2.name: Diplomat
2.meaning: Partnership, patience and the gift of bringing people together.

3.name: Creator
3.meaning: Self-expression through words, art and humour, spreading joy around.

4.name: Builder
4.meaning: The energy that builds solid foundations and works with plan and reliability.

5.name: Free spirit
5.meaning: A flexible energy open to the new, learning through travel and experience.

6.name: Nurturer
6.meaning: Care for family and people, and harmony at home.

7.name: Seeker
7.meaning: The energy that seeks truth, thinks deeply and grows strong in solitude.

8.name: Power
8.meaning: The ability to achieve goals, manage and build material success.

9.name: Humanitarian
9.meaning: A big heart, service to humanity, and letting go to complete a cycle.

11.name: Master 11 — Illuminator
11.meaning: Strong intuition and a mission to inspire others; a high-voltage but inspiring energy.

22.name: Master 22 — Master builder
22.meaning: The potential to turn big dreams into real, lasting works.

33.name: Master 33 — Master teacher
33.meaning: Guiding others with love and compassion; selfless service.

lifePath.meaning: From the birth date: the main theme and direction of your life.

expression.name: Expression (destiny)

soulUrge.name: Soul urge
soulUrge.meaning: From the vowels of the name: your heart's deepest desire.

personality.name: Personality
personality.meaning: From the consonants of the name: how others see you.

birthday.name: Birthday
birthday.meaning: From the day of birth: a special talent.

maturity.name: Maturity
maturity.meaning: Life path + expression: potential that unfolds in the second half of life.

personalYear.name: Personal year
personalYear.meaning: The energy of this year: where you are in the 9-year cycle.

karmicDebt.13: Learning through effort: overcoming laziness and finishing what you start.
karmicDebt.14: Using freedom wisely: avoiding excess and dependency.
karmicDebt.16: Rebuilding the ego: from pride to humility.
karmicDebt.19: Learning independence the right way: being able to ask for help.

dayMaster.name: Day Master
dayMaster.meaning: You yourself: the core of the character.

sevenKillings.name: Seven Killings (Qi Sha)
sevenKillings.meaning: pressure, courage, a test of leadership

soul.name: Life palace
soul.meaning: Personality, character, the main theme of life.

wealth.name: Wealth
wealth.meaning: How money is earned and spent.

surface.name: Travel
surface.meaning: Life away from home, travel, public image.

sun.aries: Your core is a pioneer's: you come alive when there is something to start, win or defend. Directness is your honesty; patience is your lesson.
sun.taurus: You are built for steadiness: you grow by creating things that last and by enjoying what is real and tangible. Change comes slowly, but what you commit to, you keep.
sun.gemini: Your vitality comes from curiosity: ideas, conversations and connections keep you awake. You learn by asking, and you are at your best when you can explain what you have learned.
sun.cancer: At your core is the instinct to protect and nourish: home, family and emotional safety give you strength. Your sensitivity is a resource, not a weakness.
sun.leo: You shine by expressing yourself: creativity, generosity and warmth are your natural language. You need to be seen, and when you are, you light up the people around you.
sun.virgo: Your strength lies in refinement: you see what can be improved and quietly make it better. Being useful gives you meaning; the lesson is to be as kind to yourself as you are precise.
sun.libra: You come alive in relationship: balance, beauty and fairness are what you instinctively seek. You see every side of a question, which makes you a natural mediator and sometimes a slow decider.
sun.scorpio: Your core is intense and private: you want depth, truth and real transformation, not surface. You are loyal and perceptive, and you rebuild yourself after every crisis.
sun.sagittarius: You are driven by meaning and horizons: travel, learning and big questions feed your spirit. Optimism is your gift; following through is the skill to develop.
sun.capricorn: You are built for long goals: discipline, responsibility and a steady climb define you. You often mature early, and your achievements grow with time.
sun.aquarius: Your core is independent and forward-looking: you think in systems, groups and future possibilities. You value freedom and authenticity, even when they set you apart.
sun.pisces: You are imaginative and deeply empathetic: you sense what others feel and draw on a rich inner world. Art, compassion and spirituality are natural outlets; clear boundaries keep you strong.

moon.aries: Emotionally you react fast and honestly: feelings flare up and pass quickly. You feel safe when you can act, and you need room to let off steam.
moon.taurus: You need calm, comfort and predictability to feel secure. Good food, nature and touch soothe you, and your moods are steady and enduring.
moon.gemini: You process feelings by talking and thinking them through. Variety and conversation keep you emotionally balanced; boredom unsettles you more than conflict.
moon.cancer: Your emotional world is deep and protective: you remember feelings for a long time and care for people instinctively. Home and close bonds are your emotional anchor.
moon.leo: You need warmth, appreciation and a little drama in your emotional life. When you feel loved and noticed, you give generously and loyally.
moon.virgo: You calm down by putting things in order: routines, practical help and solving small problems soothe you. Worry is your stress signal; usefulness is your comfort.
moon.libra: Emotional harmony matters a lot to you: tension in relationships unsettles you quickly. You feel best in pleasant surroundings, with a partner or close friend to share things with.
moon.scorpio: Your feelings run deep and you rarely show all of them. You need trust and emotional honesty; once betrayed, you find it hard to forget.
moon.sagittarius: You need freedom and something to look forward to: plans, trips and new ideas lift your mood. You bounce back quickly and prefer optimism to brooding.
moon.capricorn: You keep your feelings under control and feel safest when life is structured. You show love through responsibility and practical support rather than words.
moon.aquarius: You need emotional space and like to understand your feelings from a little distance. Friendship and shared ideals mean a lot to you, and you dislike emotional pressure.
moon.pisces: You are emotionally porous: you absorb the moods of the people and places around you. Quiet, music, water and creative time restore you; you need time alone to recharge.

asc.aries: People see you as direct, energetic and quick to act. You meet new situations head-on, and the first impression you make is bold.
asc.taurus: You come across as calm, grounded and pleasant to be around. You approach new things carefully and prefer to take your time.
asc.gemini: You come across as lively, curious and talkative. You meet the world with questions and adapt quickly to new people.
asc.cancer: At first you come across as gentle, caring and somewhat reserved. You feel out a situation before opening up, and people sense they can trust you.
asc.leo: You have a noticeable presence: warm, confident and expressive. People remember you, and you naturally take centre stage.
asc.virgo: You come across as modest, attentive and composed. You notice details and approach life practically and thoughtfully.
asc.libra: You come across as charming, polite and easy to talk to. You approach people diplomatically and care about appearance and atmosphere.
asc.scorpio: You come across as intense, perceptive and hard to read. You observe before revealing yourself, and people sense your depth.
asc.sagittarius: You come across as open, friendly and full of enthusiasm. You approach life as an adventure and put people at ease with your humour.
asc.capricorn: You come across as serious, reliable and self-possessed. You approach new situations with caution and a clear sense of purpose.
asc.aquarius: You come across as original, friendly and a little unconventional. You treat people as equals and stand out without trying.
asc.pisces: You come across as soft, dreamy and sensitive. You take in the atmosphere around you, and people find it easy to open up to you.

mercury.aries: You think fast and speak your mind: quick decisions, short sentences, little patience for long explanations.
mercury.taurus: You think slowly and thoroughly: once you reach a conclusion, it is hard to change your mind. You learn best through practice and the senses.
mercury.gemini: Your mind is quick, versatile and curious about everything. You connect ideas easily, enjoy wordplay and can hold several threads at once.
mercury.cancer: You think through feeling and memory: you remember how something felt better than the facts. Your words are caring, and you choose them with emotional tact.
mercury.leo: You speak with confidence and warmth, and you like your ideas to be heard. You are a natural storyteller and persuade with enthusiasm.
mercury.virgo: Your mind is analytical and precise: you notice details, errors and how things can work better. You think best with lists, plans and clear facts.
mercury.libra: You think by weighing both sides and speak diplomatically. You are good at negotiation and finding the fair middle, though decisions can take time.
mercury.scorpio: Your mind is probing and perceptive: you look for what is hidden and are not satisfied with surface answers. You keep secrets well and speak with intensity.
mercury.sagittarius: You think in big pictures and are drawn to philosophy, travel and ideas about meaning. You speak frankly, sometimes too frankly, and teach naturally.
mercury.capricorn: Your thinking is practical, structured and goal-oriented. You speak carefully, value expertise and prefer plans that actually work.
mercury.aquarius: Your mind is original and independent: you question rules and enjoy unusual ideas, technology and systems. You think best when you are free to disagree.
mercury.pisces: You think in images, impressions and intuition rather than straight lines. You understand people without words and express yourself well through art, music or metaphor.

venus.aries: In love you are direct and passionate: you like the chase, quick sparks and honesty. Boredom cools you faster than conflict.
venus.taurus: You love steadily and sensually: comfort, beauty, touch and loyalty matter most. You show affection through care, gifts and time spent together.
venus.gemini: You fall for minds: conversation, humour and variety keep your interest. You need a partner who is also a friend you can talk to about everything.
venus.cancer: You love protectively and tenderly: emotional safety and closeness come first. You show love by caring for people and making them feel at home.
venus.leo: You love generously and openly, with romance and grand gestures. You want to admire your partner and to be admired in return.
venus.virgo: You show love through attention and practical help. You notice small needs, value reliability and prefer quiet devotion to big words.
venus.libra: Love and partnership are central to you: you seek harmony, fairness and beauty in relationships. You are charming and attentive, and you dislike open conflict.
venus.scorpio: You love intensely and all the way: you want depth, loyalty and complete honesty. Superficial relationships do not interest you; trust is earned slowly.
venus.sagittarius: You love freely and adventurously: shared journeys, laughter and growth matter more than routine. You need a partner who gives you room to explore.
venus.capricorn: You take love seriously: commitment, reliability and shared goals matter to you. You may open up slowly, but your loyalty lasts.
venus.aquarius: You love as a friend first: you need independence, honesty and a meeting of minds. Unusual relationships do not scare you; possessiveness does.
venus.pisces: You love romantically and selflessly: you idealise the people you love and sense their feelings deeply. Clear boundaries help keep your generosity healthy.

mars.aries: Your drive is direct, fast and competitive. You act first and think later, start things with great energy and need physical outlets.
mars.taurus: You act slowly but with great endurance: once you set a course, you do not give up. You are hard to provoke and hard to stop.
mars.gemini: Your energy goes into words and ideas: you argue well, multitask and get restless without variety. You fight with wit rather than force.
mars.cancer: You act to protect what you love. Your anger tends to be indirect or emotional, and you are strongest when defending family or home.
mars.leo: You act with pride, courage and flair. You want your efforts to be seen and you lead naturally, especially in creative or competitive settings.
mars.virgo: Your energy is precise and methodical: you work hard, improve things step by step and like a job done properly. Stress can turn into over-criticism.
mars.libra: You act through cooperation and diplomacy and prefer to avoid open confrontation. You fight hardest for fairness, for yourself and for others.
mars.scorpio: Your drive is intense, focused and strategic. You do not give up easily, work well under pressure and can channel great willpower toward a goal.
mars.sagittarius: You act with enthusiasm and optimism, especially for causes and adventures you believe in. You need freedom of movement; routine drains you.
mars.capricorn: Your drive is disciplined and ambitious: you set long-term goals and climb steadily. You control your energy well and get things done.
mars.aquarius: You act independently and for ideals: you fight for change, groups and causes larger than yourself. You resist being told what to do.
mars.pisces: Your energy flows rather than pushes: you act on intuition and inspiration, often for others. You avoid direct conflict and work best when you believe in the purpose.

jupiter.aries: Growth comes through courage and initiative: you are lucky when you take the first step and lead.
jupiter.taurus: Growth comes through patience and building resources: you prosper by steady work, good taste and enjoying life's comforts.
jupiter.gemini: Growth comes through learning, communication and connections: many interests and contacts bring you opportunities.
jupiter.cancer: Growth comes through caring, family and emotional generosity: you feel most abundant when you nurture others.
jupiter.leo: Growth comes through creativity and generous self-expression: your warmth and confidence open doors.
jupiter.virgo: Growth comes through useful work, skill and service: you prosper by improving things and helping in practical ways.
jupiter.libra: Growth comes through partnerships, fairness and diplomacy: good relationships bring you luck.
jupiter.scorpio: Growth comes through depth, research and transformation: you gain by facing what others avoid and by sharing resources.
jupiter.sagittarius: Growth comes naturally through travel, study and faith: broad horizons and optimism bring you opportunities.
jupiter.capricorn: Growth comes through discipline and responsibility: success arrives slowly but lasts, and it grows with experience.
jupiter.aquarius: Growth comes through ideas, communities and innovation: you benefit by thinking ahead and working with like-minded people.
jupiter.pisces: Growth comes through compassion, imagination and spiritual life: generosity and faith bring their own rewards.

saturn.aries: Your life lesson involves self-assertion: learning to act with patience and to lead without fear or impulsiveness.
saturn.taurus: Your life lesson involves security and self-worth: building lasting resources without fear of loss.
saturn.gemini: Your life lesson involves communication and learning: trusting your mind and speaking with clarity and depth.
saturn.cancer: Your life lesson involves emotional security and family: learning to care for yourself and to set healthy boundaries.
saturn.leo: Your life lesson involves self-expression: learning to shine and create without needing outside approval.
saturn.virgo: Your life lesson involves work and health: building good routines without sliding into perfectionism.
saturn.libra: Your life lesson involves relationships: learning commitment, fairness and balance between giving and receiving.
saturn.scorpio: Your life lesson involves trust and control: learning to share power, intimacy and resources without fear.
saturn.sagittarius: Your life lesson involves beliefs and meaning: building a personal philosophy grounded in experience, not dogma.
saturn.capricorn: Saturn is strong here: you have natural discipline and authority, and the lesson is to balance ambition with warmth.
saturn.aquarius: Your life lesson involves individuality within the group: building structures that serve people while staying yourself.
saturn.pisces: Your life lesson involves faith and boundaries: giving form to dreams and compassion without losing yourself.

uranus.aries: Generational: your generation breaks new ground through bold, individual action and pioneering independence.
uranus.taurus: Generational: your generation changes how people relate to money, resources, food and the material world.
uranus.gemini: Generational: your generation revolutionises communication, information and the way people learn and connect.
uranus.cancer: Generational: your generation reinvents the idea of home, family and emotional belonging.
uranus.leo: Generational: your generation seeks freedom in self-expression, creativity and personal style.
uranus.virgo: Generational: your generation brings change to work, health, technology and daily routines.
uranus.libra: Generational: your generation redefines partnership, marriage and equality in relationships.
uranus.scorpio: Generational: your generation breaks taboos around intimacy, power, money and transformation.
uranus.sagittarius: Generational: your generation questions beliefs and opens new horizons in travel, education and worldview.
uranus.capricorn: Generational: your generation reshapes institutions, careers and structures of authority.
uranus.aquarius: Generational: your generation is drawn to networks, technology, social ideals and collective change.
uranus.pisces: Generational: your generation seeks freedom through imagination, spirituality and dissolving old boundaries.

neptune.aries: Generational: your generation dreams of heroic action and idealises courage and new beginnings.
neptune.taurus: Generational: your generation idealises nature, beauty and material security.
neptune.gemini: Generational: your generation dreams through words, stories and new forms of communication.
neptune.cancer: Generational: your generation idealises home, homeland and family belonging.
neptune.leo: Generational: your generation romanticises love, glamour and creative self-expression.
neptune.virgo: Generational: your generation finds ideals in service, health and useful work.
neptune.libra: Generational: your generation idealises love, harmony and peace between people.
neptune.scorpio: Generational: your generation is drawn to the hidden, the psychological and the mystical.
neptune.sagittarius: Generational: your generation seeks spiritual truth through travel, philosophy and faith.
neptune.capricorn: Generational: your generation dissolves and reimagines old structures, authority and tradition.
neptune.aquarius: Generational: your generation dreams of a connected humanity, technology and collective ideals.
neptune.pisces: Generational: Neptune is at home here; your generation is highly sensitive, imaginative and spiritually open.

pluto.aries: Generational: your generation transforms the world through bold individual will and new beginnings.
pluto.taurus: Generational: your generation transforms values, resources and the relationship with the earth.
pluto.gemini: Generational: your generation transforms information, media and the power of ideas.
pluto.cancer: Generational: your generation lives through deep changes in family, home and homeland.
pluto.leo: Generational: your generation transforms self-expression, leadership and the role of the individual.
pluto.virgo: Generational: your generation transforms work, health, technology and everyday life.
pluto.libra: Generational: your generation transforms relationships, marriage and ideas of justice.
pluto.scorpio: Generational: Pluto is strong here; your generation faces taboos, power and transformation head-on.
pluto.sagittarius: Generational: your generation transforms beliefs, education and global connections.
pluto.capricorn: Generational: your generation transforms institutions, governments and economic structures.
pluto.aquarius: Generational: your generation transforms society through technology, networks and collective power.
pluto.pisces: Generational: your generation transforms spirituality, art and the boundaries between people.

sun.1: Your identity is on display: you are noticed easily, and life asks you to lead with your own personality.
sun.2: You build self-esteem by earning, owning and developing your talents; financial independence matters to you.
sun.3: You shine through words, learning and everyday contacts; writing, teaching or siblings can play a big role.
sun.4: Home, family and roots are central to who you are; you often come into your own in the second half of life.
sun.5: You come alive through creativity, romance, play and children; self-expression is a need, not a luxury.
sun.6: You find meaning in useful work, skill and daily routines; health and service are important themes.
sun.7: You discover yourself through partners and close relationships; cooperation brings out your best.
sun.8: You are drawn to depth: shared resources, intimacy, psychology and transformation shape your life.
sun.9: You grow through travel, study and big ideas; a personal philosophy gives your life direction.
sun.10: Career and public role are central: you want to achieve something visible and be recognised for it.
sun.11: You shine in groups, friendships and shared causes; your hopes for the future drive you.
sun.12: Your light works best behind the scenes: solitude, inner life, spirituality and quietly helping others matter to you.

moon.1: Your feelings show on your face; you are responsive and sensitive, and your moods affect how you come across.
moon.2: Emotional security is tied to material security; saving and having your own resources calms you.
moon.3: You need to talk about your feelings; close contact with siblings, neighbours and your local area matters.
moon.4: This is the Moon's natural house: family, home and a private refuge are deeply important to your well-being.
moon.5: You find emotional fulfilment in creativity, romance, play and children.
moon.6: Your mood is linked to routines, work and health; a well-ordered day keeps you balanced.
moon.7: You need emotional partnership; you feel secure when you have someone close to share life with.
moon.8: Your emotions are intense and private; deep bonds and trust are essential to you.
moon.9: You feel at home in the wider world: travel, learning and faith nourish you emotionally.
moon.10: Your feelings are tied to your public life; you may work with people, in care or with the public.
moon.11: Friends and community are your emotional support; you feel safe among like-minded people.
moon.12: You need time alone to process feelings; your inner world is rich and often hidden from others.

mercury.1: You come across as quick, talkative and curious; your mind is a central part of your personality.
mercury.2: You think a lot about money and value; you can earn through words, trade or ideas.
mercury.3: This is Mercury's natural house: learning, writing, talking and short trips fill your daily life.
mercury.4: Your thinking is shaped by home and family; you may work from home or talk things over a lot within the family.
mercury.5: You think creatively and playfully; you enjoy games, stories and creative writing.
mercury.6: Your mind is practical and detail-oriented; you think best about work, health and improving things.
mercury.7: You think best in dialogue; partners, clients and negotiations stimulate your mind.
mercury.8: Your mind goes deep: research, psychology, secrets and investigation attract you.
mercury.9: You are drawn to higher learning, languages, travel and big ideas.
mercury.10: Communication plays a key role in your career; you may be known for your ideas or your words.
mercury.11: You exchange ideas in groups and networks; friends stimulate your thinking.
mercury.12: Much of your thinking happens inwardly; intuition, reflection and quiet study suit you.

venus.1: You come across as charming and pleasant; appearance and style matter to you.
venus.2: You value comfort and beautiful things and can earn through art, beauty or good taste.
venus.3: You speak kindly and diplomatically; relationships with siblings and neighbours tend to be warm.
venus.4: A beautiful, harmonious home is important to you; family life brings you pleasure.
venus.5: Romance, pleasure, art and creativity bring you joy; love affairs play a big role.
venus.6: You enjoy a pleasant workplace and good relations with colleagues; your work may involve beauty or care.
venus.7: Partnership is central for you; you seek harmony in marriage and close relationships.
venus.8: Love is deep and intense for you; shared finances and intimacy are important themes.
venus.9: You love travel, foreign cultures and learning; love may come from afar.
venus.10: Charm helps your career; work in art, beauty, diplomacy or with people suits you.
venus.11: You enjoy friendship and social life; friends can become partners.
venus.12: Your love is private and selfless; you may have secret feelings or a strongly compassionate side.

mars.1: You come across as energetic, direct and assertive; you act quickly.
mars.2: You work hard to earn and defend your resources; you can be impulsive with money.
mars.3: You speak sharply and debate eagerly; your mind is quick and competitive.
mars.4: Your energy goes into home and family; there may be tension at home, or you work hard on it.
mars.5: You are passionate in love, sport and creative pursuits; competition energises you.
mars.6: You work energetically and hard; exercise is important for your health.
mars.7: Relationships are dynamic and sometimes combative; you may attract strong-willed partners.
mars.8: You have great willpower and intensity; shared resources and power can become areas of struggle.
mars.9: You fight for your beliefs and love adventure, sport and travel.
mars.10: You are ambitious and driven in your career; you want to lead and achieve.
mars.11: You put energy into groups and causes; you can be a leader among friends.
mars.12: Your drive works behind the scenes; anger can stay hidden, so healthy outlets matter.

jupiter.1: You come across as optimistic, generous and confident; luck often follows personal initiative.
jupiter.2: There is good potential for income and resources; generosity with money comes naturally.
jupiter.3: Learning, writing and communication bring opportunities; you have a broad mind.
jupiter.4: A spacious home and a supportive family are blessings; life tends to improve over time.
jupiter.5: Joy, creativity, romance and children bring growth and good fortune.
jupiter.6: Work and service bring growth; you enjoy helping and usually find good work.
jupiter.7: Partnerships bring luck and growth; you may meet generous or wise partners.
jupiter.8: You can benefit from shared resources, inheritance or investment, and from deep inner work.
jupiter.9: This is Jupiter's natural house: travel, study, teaching and faith bring great opportunities.
jupiter.10: There are good prospects for career success and public recognition.
jupiter.11: Friends, networks and groups bring opportunities; your hopes tend to grow and come true.
jupiter.12: Hidden protection: faith, compassion and inner life support you in difficult times.

saturn.1: You come across as serious and responsible; confidence grows with age and experience.
saturn.2: Money comes through steady effort; the lesson is to build security without fear of scarcity.
saturn.3: You think carefully and take learning seriously; the lesson is to trust your own voice.
saturn.4: Home and family carry responsibility; you build your own stable base step by step.
saturn.5: Joy and self-expression may need to be learned; creativity matures with discipline.
saturn.6: You are a dedicated, reliable worker; your health benefits from steady routines.
saturn.7: You take relationships seriously; commitment may come later but tends to last.
saturn.8: Trust and intimacy take time; you learn to handle shared resources responsibly.
saturn.9: You build your worldview carefully; serious study and structured learning suit you.
saturn.10: This is Saturn's natural house: career success comes through hard work and grows over time.
saturn.11: You value a few loyal friends; taking responsibility within groups comes naturally.
saturn.12: Hidden fears or responsibilities work in the background; solitude and reflection help you.

uranus.1: You come across as original and independent; change and freedom are part of your identity.
uranus.2: Income may be irregular or unconventional; technology or new ideas can bring money.
uranus.3: Your thinking is original and fast; you may have unusual ideas or ways of communicating.
uranus.4: Home life may be unusual or change often; you need freedom even in your own home.
uranus.5: Your creativity and love life are unconventional; sudden romances are possible.
uranus.6: You need freedom at work; flexible or technology-related jobs suit you.
uranus.7: You need freedom in relationships; partners may be unusual, or relationships may change suddenly.
uranus.8: Sudden changes in shared resources or deep psychological breakthroughs are possible.
uranus.9: Your beliefs are independent; unusual philosophies, travel and new knowledge attract you.
uranus.10: Your career may take unexpected turns; you need independence and innovation in your work.
uranus.11: This is Uranus's natural house: unusual friends, networks and progressive ideals are important.
uranus.12: Sudden insights come from the unconscious; your independence may be hidden or inward.

neptune.1: You come across as gentle, dreamy or hard to define; you absorb your surroundings easily.
neptune.2: Money and values can be idealistic or unclear; financial clarity needs attention.
neptune.3: Your thinking is imaginative and intuitive; you communicate well through images and stories.
neptune.4: Home may be idealised or unclear; you long for a peaceful, almost sacred refuge.
neptune.5: Your creativity is inspired and romantic; art, music or theatre can be a gift.
neptune.6: You want to serve and help; care, healing or the arts suit you, but routines need attention.
neptune.7: You may idealise partners; seeing them as they are is the lesson in relationships.
neptune.8: You are drawn to the mystical and the hidden; boundaries in intimacy and shared money matter.
neptune.9: You have a spiritual, idealistic worldview; travel and philosophy inspire you.
neptune.10: Your career may be connected with art, care or ideals; your public image can be glamorous or vague.
neptune.11: You have idealistic hopes and gentle friendships; choose friends with clear eyes.
neptune.12: This is Neptune's natural house: a rich inner world, intuition and spiritual sensitivity.

pluto.1: You have a powerful, intense presence; you transform yourself several times in life.
pluto.2: Resources and self-worth go through deep transformations; you can build wealth, lose it and rebuild it.
pluto.3: Your mind is penetrating and persuasive; words carry power for you.
pluto.4: Deep family dynamics shape you; home can be a place of transformation.
pluto.5: Love and creativity are intense and transformative; you put your whole self into them.
pluto.6: You can transform work and health habits deeply; you are a powerful, thorough worker.
pluto.7: Relationships are intense and transformative; power dynamics with partners need awareness.
pluto.8: This is Pluto's natural house: deep psychology, intimacy and transformation are central themes.
pluto.9: Your beliefs go through deep transformations; you look for the truth behind ideas.
pluto.10: You seek power and influence in your career; your public life may change radically.
pluto.11: You can influence groups and society; friendships may transform you.
pluto.12: Deep forces work in your unconscious; inner work and solitude bring powerful healing.

aspectPairs.sun-moon: Links your will and your emotional needs: how well what you want and what you need work together.
aspectPairs.sun-mercury: Your identity and your mind are closely joined: you think and speak from who you are.
aspectPairs.sun-venus: Links identity with love, charm and pleasure: how you express affection and enjoy life.
aspectPairs.sun-mars: Links identity with drive and will: how you assert yourself and use your energy.
aspectPairs.sun-jupiter: Links identity with growth and optimism: your confidence, generosity and eye for opportunity.
aspectPairs.sun-saturn: Links identity with responsibility and limits: discipline, self-doubt and the slow building of authority.
aspectPairs.sun-uranus: Links identity with freedom and change: your need to be original and independent.
aspectPairs.sun-neptune: Links identity with imagination and ideals: inspiration, sensitivity and at times an unclear sense of self.
aspectPairs.sun-pluto: Links identity with power and transformation: intensity, willpower and deep personal change.
aspectPairs.moon-mercury: Links feelings and thoughts: how easily you put emotions into words.
aspectPairs.moon-venus: Links emotional needs with love and pleasure: tenderness, comfort and how you give and receive affection.
aspectPairs.moon-mars: Links feelings with action: emotional reactions, temper and the courage to protect what you care about.
aspectPairs.moon-jupiter: Links feelings with generosity and optimism: emotional warmth, faith and a big heart.
aspectPairs.moon-saturn: Links feelings with control and duty: emotional restraint, a need for security and maturity.
aspectPairs.moon-uranus: Links feelings with freedom: sudden mood changes and a need for emotional independence.
aspectPairs.moon-neptune: Links feelings with imagination and empathy: deep sensitivity, intuition and a dreamy emotional life.
aspectPairs.moon-pluto: Links feelings with intensity and transformation: deep emotions, strong attachments and emotional power.
aspectPairs.mercury-venus: Links mind with charm: a pleasant way with words, diplomacy and artistic thinking.
aspectPairs.mercury-mars: Links mind with drive: quick, sharp thinking, debate and decisive speech.
aspectPairs.mercury-jupiter: Links mind with breadth: big-picture thinking, learning and optimism in ideas.
aspectPairs.mercury-saturn: Links mind with structure: careful, serious, disciplined thinking.
aspectPairs.mercury-uranus: Links mind with originality: flashes of insight, inventive ideas and quick, unusual thinking.
aspectPairs.mercury-neptune: Links mind with imagination: intuitive, poetic thinking, and sometimes vagueness.
aspectPairs.mercury-pluto: Links mind with depth: penetrating, investigative thinking and persuasive words.
aspectPairs.venus-mars: Links love with desire: attraction, passion and the balance between giving and taking.
aspectPairs.venus-jupiter: Links love with abundance: generosity, warmth, pleasure and sometimes excess.
aspectPairs.venus-saturn: Links love with commitment: loyalty, seriousness in relationships and fear of rejection.
aspectPairs.venus-uranus: Links love with freedom: sudden attractions, unconventional relationships and a need for space.
aspectPairs.venus-neptune: Links love with ideals: romance, compassion, artistic sensitivity and a tendency to idealise.
aspectPairs.venus-pluto: Links love with intensity: deep, transformative attraction and strong emotional bonds.
aspectPairs.mars-jupiter: Links drive with growth: enthusiasm, ambition and energy for big goals.
aspectPairs.mars-saturn: Links drive with discipline: endurance, controlled effort and sometimes frustration.
aspectPairs.mars-uranus: Links drive with freedom: sudden action, independence and restless energy.
aspectPairs.mars-neptune: Links drive with ideals: acting on inspiration or for others, sometimes with unclear goals.
aspectPairs.mars-pluto: Links drive with power: enormous willpower, intensity and the ability to push through almost anything.
aspectPairs.jupiter-saturn: Links growth with structure: the balance between expansion and caution on your life path.
aspectPairs.jupiter-uranus: Links growth with innovation: sudden opportunities, breakthroughs and a love of freedom.
aspectPairs.jupiter-neptune: Links growth with ideals: spirituality, compassion, big dreams and faith.
aspectPairs.jupiter-pluto: Links growth with power: ambition, influence and the drive for large-scale change.
aspectPairs.saturn-uranus: Links tradition with change: the tension between stability and freedom; often generational.
aspectPairs.saturn-neptune: Links reality with dreams: giving form to ideals, or disillusionment; often generational.
aspectPairs.saturn-pluto: Links structure with power: endurance under pressure and deep restructuring; often generational.
aspectPairs.uranus-neptune: A generational link between innovation and ideals, shared by everyone born in these years.
aspectPairs.uranus-pluto: A generational link between change and transformation, shared by everyone born in these years.
aspectPairs.neptune-pluto: A very slow generational link between ideals and transformation, shared by whole generations.

planetCycles.sun: Your Sun meets its own natal place: a yearly checkpoint for identity, vitality and direction (the conjunction is your solar return).
planetCycles.moon: The Moon meets its own natal place every month: a monthly emotional reset.
planetCycles.mercury: A Mercury cycle: a fresh round of thinking, planning and conversation about your usual concerns.
planetCycles.venus: A Venus cycle: love, pleasure and what you value come back into focus.
planetCycles.mars: A Mars cycle (about two years): a new phase for drive, ambition and the way you assert yourself.
planetCycles.jupiter: A Jupiter cycle (about 12 years): a phase of growth, opportunity and widening horizons.
planetCycles.saturn: A Saturn cycle (about 29 years): a checkpoint of maturity, responsibility and long-term structure; squares and oppositions test what you have built.
planetCycles.uranus: A Uranus cycle (about 84 years): life-stage turning points around freedom and change; the opposition is the midlife awakening.
planetCycles.neptune: A Neptune cycle (about 165 years): slow shifts in ideals, faith and imagination; the square usually comes in midlife.
planetCycles.pluto: A Pluto cycle: slow, deep transformation of power and inner life; the square is a generational midlife marker.
planetCycles.chiron: A Chiron cycle (about 50 years): old wounds resurface to be healed; the return comes around age 50.
planetCycles.northNode: A nodal cycle (about 18.6 years): a turning point in life direction and purpose.
